title: The Wrong answer in the sum
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：wrong　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wrong 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the grower wrote of ① a wrong answer in the sum in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so wrong that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the wrong ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the wrong answer in the sum that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too wrong to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the wrong ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a wrong man for the job, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as wrong as the man for the job they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was wrong or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something wrong, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite wrong; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the wrong ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, with great care, she wrote of another wrong answer in the sum in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less wrong than anybody had expected. ⑩ The wrong man for the job that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the wrong ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 错误（前置定语 a wrong answer in the sum：1987 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件错误的答案）
B. adj. 错误／不合适（两处加强说法：so wrong that … 与 no less wrong than …）
C. adj. 错误／不合适（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 错误（表语 too wrong to do：母亲觉得它太错误，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 不合适（前置定语 a wrong man for the job：叔叔把整件事称作一桩不合适的人）
F. adj. 不合适（同级比较 as wrong as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩不适合这份工作的人相比）
G. adj. 不合适（后置定语 something wrong：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 不合适（受程度副词修饰 quite wrong：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a wrong answer in the sum
the wrong answer in the sum that
a wrong man for the job
The wrong man for the job that

answers.why: wrong 意为“错误”，1987 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件错误的答案”，此处作前置定语 a wrong answer in the sum。
wrong 意为“错误”，此处用 so wrong that 结构，说它错误到大棚里没人敢靠近。
wrong 意为“错误”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的错误算术题里错误的答案，等于最高级的说法。
wrong 意为“错误”，母亲认为这件东西“太错误了，谁也用不上”，too wrong to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
wrong 意为“不合适”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩不合适的人”，此处作前置定语 a wrong man for the job。
wrong 意为“不合适”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩不适合这份工作的人一样不合适”，同级比较用 as wrong as。
wrong 意为“不合适”，收成账上那半行字要的是“不合适的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something wrong。
wrong 意为“不合适”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当不合适”，quite 修饰原级 wrong。
wrong 意为“不合适”，no less wrong than 表示“其不合适不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之不合适不亚于任何人的预料。
wrong 意为“不合适”，母亲 1999 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的不合适人”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件错误的答案。（a wrong answer in the sum）
它错误到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so wrong that …）
母亲觉得它太错误，谁也用不上。（too wrong to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩不合适的人。（a wrong man for the job）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩不适合这份工作的人一样不合适。（as wrong as …）
到了 1994 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件不合适的东西。（something wrong）
answers: In 1987 the grower wrote of a wrong answer in the sum in the ledger.
It was so wrong that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too wrong to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a wrong man for the job.
He said nobody would call it as wrong as the man for the job they had once had.
By 1994 the ledger asked for nothing but something wrong.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wrong 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the grower wrote of a wrong answer in the sum in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the wrong answer in the sum that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too wrong to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a wrong man for the job, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite wrong, and everybody laughed.
The wrong ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
